mapper.sql: select actor_member_id as actor, owner_member_id as owner, request_id as requestId, scope, source_id as sourceId, source_version as sourceVersion, request_hash as requestHash, status, draft_id as draftId, draft_version as draftVersion, reason from template_adoption_receipt
mapper.insert: insert into template_adoption_receipt(actor_member_id, request_id, owner_member_id, scope, source_id, source_version, request_hash, status) values(#{actor}, #{requestId}, #{owner}, #{scope}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceVersion}, #{requestHash}, 'PENDING') on duplicate key update request_id = request_id
mapper.select: where actor_member_id=#{actor} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
select member_template_id from cms_template_library where id=#{id}
mapper.update: update template_adoption_receipt set status=#{status}, draft_id=#{draftId}, reason=#{reason}, draft_version=#{draftVersion} where actor_member_id=#{actor} and request_id=#{requestId} and status='PENDING'
